title: Extract constant (manual fix for magic literals)
summary: Turns one number or string literal into a named constant and replaces every occurrence in the unit; manual fix of the magic-literal rules
intro: Read this when a literal should become a named constant. Give the line (and the column when the line holds several literals) and the name; without --name the plan proposes one. Occurrences inside other const declarations, attributes, uses clauses, or in a context of a different declared type are left and listed on stderr. The fix is risky and manual only: a batch --fix never applies it.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint lint --in <F> [--db <db>] --enable <rule> --fix --fix-rule <rule> --fix-line <n> [--col <c>] [--name <ident>] [--apply] [--project <X.dproj>] - extract the literal at line n (column c) into a named constant and replace every occurrence in the unit; <rule> = extract-constant (any number or string literal, OFF by default, reports only when its fix is asked for), magic-literal, large-magic-number or case-magic-numbers; risky, manual only (a batch --fix withholds it); report on stderr

steps: Put the caret on a number or string literal in the editor
Edit the proposed name in the prompt and press OK; the engine report (replaced and left occurrences) is shown

surfaces.caption: drag-lint > Extract Constant (literal at cursor)...
steps: Put the caret on a number or string literal
Right-click in the editor, open the drag-lint submenu and choose Extract Constant (literal at cursor)...
Edit the proposed name in the prompt and press OK
